def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
        for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
            if r==rr and {c,cc}=={0,w-1}:
                for x in range(w): out[r][x]=1
            if c==cc and {r,rr}=={0,h-1}:
                for x in range(h): out[x][c]=1
    # Turn entire 2-components touched by a marker/line to 1.
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        if out[r][c]!=2 or (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; touched=False
        while stack:
          y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
          for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
            if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w:
              if out[yy][xx]==1: touched=True
              elif out[yy][xx]==2 and (yy,xx) not in seen: seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
        if touched:
          for y,x in comp: out[y][x]=1
    return out
PY
